name: strip_style
title: Remove ANSI escape sequences from a string

origin.description: Remove ANSI CSI sequences from each string.
origin.details: Uses the same pattern as has_style. The bytes of the visible text are left as they were.
origin.value: The string with escape sequences removed.

translation.description: Remove ANSI CSI sequences from each string.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: A string or a list of strings.

translation.details: The same CSI pattern as has_style.
translation.value: The string, or a list of strings, without escape sequences.
